=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:628-631 (live copy; twin workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR changes both copies of the hook, but the last autofix edited only the template (blob 8c7a08462c9e) and left the live copy at blob 6f7f5b28b138, so the two copies differ. The live copy still uses `reason.startswith("helper:test_")` and lacks `_UNITTEST_QUALIFIED_RE`, `full_names`/`full_unittest_names`, `_output_failing_set`/`_unittest_qualified_names`/`_unit_unittest_names`, the `_failing_names_readable` bypass and the qualified-name loop in `classify_baseline`.
  WHY: `pending_template_paths()` (tests/claude_template_drift.py:100-104) does not exempt a path that both copies changed, so test_live_copies_match_their_templates fails in PR CI, on main and in the release gates, and the PR holds a merge-lease slot. The live interactive hook also misclassifies `ClassB.test_same` as inherited, marks unittest output over 4 KB as `baseline_names_unreadable`, and misses `helper:caps_test` / `helper:caps` entries. All four reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:169, 465-472 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_TEST_MODULE_IMPORT_RE` captures only the first module of a multi-module import statement, so `import os, test_caps` records `os`.
  WHY: A test that imports a selected test helper in the comma form is missing from the `importers` map, so rule 3 does not select it and its failure escapes the gate. Severities disagree: gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR; glm rated it NIT because the existing rule-3 regex at line 485 has the same shape, so this mirrors an existing limitation. The highest rating was used.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:867-876, 887-902, 1085-1103 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_unittest_qualified_names()` cuts the list at `MAX_PARSED_NAMES` (50), but `_failing_names_readable()` checks only the deduplicated method-only count from `_unit_failing_set()`, so qualified names past the 50th are never compared.
  WHY: When more than 50 classes fail the same method, a new failure in a class past the cap is classified as inherited and ships. This is a narrower form of the hole #10249 closes. Severities disagree: minimax and luna rated it MAJOR; sonnet and glm rated it NIT. The highest rating was used.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:894 (also .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_failing_names_readable` returns False (unreadable) when `len(names) >= MAX_PARSED_NAMES` (50).
  WHY: A suite that reliably fails 50 or more tests is always treated as unreadable, which prevents inherited-failure classification and forces an unverified/repair turn even when the failures have not changed.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:764-779 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_run_one()` decodes the whole output into a second string with no upper bound when it exceeds TAIL_BYTES, then runs two regex passes over it.
  WHY: A chatty failing suite with concurrent units can OOM the gate container, which records a spurious `status=error`/unverified result that hides the real failure. Severities disagree: gemini rated it MAJOR, minimax rated it NIT, glm raised it only as a hardening suggestion, and sonnet called it speculative and did not report it. The highest rating was used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "(e) the live hook and its template twin stay identical (`tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py` already checks this)." / "The change edits `.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py`, its template twin…"
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (must byte-match workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The last run's changed-file list leaves out .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, and the copies end at different blobs (live 6f7f5b28b138, template 8c7a08462c9e). The live `_is_indirect_entry` at lines 628-631 still uses `reason.startswith("helper:test_")`. The live copy lacks `_UNITTEST_QUALIFIED_RE`, `full_names`/`full_unittest_names`, `_unittest_qualified_names`, `_unit_unittest_names` and the qualified-name loop in `classify_baseline`; grep shows these exist only in the template. The PR acceptance table marks tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py as "unmet", and that test will fail in PR CI.
- requirement: "For every inherited unit, keep the first failing assertion or error line of the baseline run in the gate log."
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py: `_run_one()` and `classify_baseline()` (and the live copy)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `classify_baseline()` passes only `base_unit.get("tail")` (the last TAIL_BYTES, 4 KB) to `baseline_first_failure()` (line 1083). `_run_one()` keeps the tail (lines 767-779) and decodes `full_text` only to parse names, not to find the first failure. With long output, the log shows a later failure line or the "last non-empty line" fallback. This contradicts the README/agents.d documentation.
- requirement: "For every inherited unit" log its first baseline failure line / "prints one line per inherited or baseline_names_unreadable unit of the validated result.json"
  expected_change_site: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh, the phase=baseline diagnostic block (lines ~483-496)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Only `rows[:200]` get per-unit lines (lines 489-492). Past the cap, the wrapper emits only an `outcome=truncated omitted=N` count (lines 493-494), without those units' first-failure lines.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, together with the live twin .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py | `_UNITTEST_QUALIFIED_RE` (line 163), `_is_indirect_entry` using `is_test_file` (line 632), `full_names`/`full_unittest_names` in `_run_one` (lines 771-779), `_output_failing_set`/`_unittest_qualified_names`/`_unit_unittest_names` (lines 847-885), the `full_names` bypass in `_failing_names_readable` (line 900), the qualified-name loop in `classify_baseline` | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR changes both copies of the hook, and they differ (live blob 6f7f5b28b138, template 8c7a08462c9e). `pending_template_paths()` (tests/claude_template_drift.py lines 100-104) leaves out paths that are in both `changed` and `live_changed`, and test_pending_drift_rejects_pr_that_changed_both_copies_differently (lines 250-255) pins this behaviour.
  WHY: test_live_copies_match_their_templates fails in PR CI, on main and in the release gates, and the PR holds a merge-lease slot. The live hook reports `ClassB.test_same` as inherited and marks unittest output over 4 KB as `baseline_names_unreadable`. Fix: make the live file match the template byte for byte, or revert the PR's live-copy hunks.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py | `_unittest_qualified_names()` returns `unique[:MAX_PARSED_NAMES]` (around line 876) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The readability check counts deduplicated method names, but the qualified list is cut at 50 entries.
  WHY: A new failure in a class past the 50th header is reported as inherited. Fix: also treat the unit as unreadable when `len(_unit_unittest_names(unit)) >= MAX_PARSED_NAMES`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "(e) the live hook and its template twin stay identical (`tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py` already checks this)." | Expected change site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, which must equal workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py | Evidence of absence: the last run's changed-file list leaves out the live file, the copies are at different blobs, and the acceptance table marks the parity test "unmet". | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "For every inherited unit, keep the first failing assertion or error line of the baseline run in the gate log." | Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py: `classify_baseline()` (`unit["baseline_first_failure"]`) and `_run_one()` | Evidence of absence: `baseline_first_failure` sees only the TAIL_BYTES tail, and `full_text` is not used to find the first failure. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- HARDENING: `_failing_names_readable()` should return False when `len(_unit_unittest_names(unit)) >= MAX_PARSED_NAMES` (2 lines); HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Notes: Not reported: the `import os, test_caps` regex miss (same shape as the existing rule-3 check, so a known limitation), the full-output decode memory concern (speculative), and the 200-row cap in scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh (an intentional, documented bound).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
